descriptions.w3d_type_list_80247300: Returns the registry that tracks every live object of this engine type.
descriptions.w3d_type_create_8024730c: Allocates and constructs a new object of this type, adds it to the type registry and increments the live count.
descriptions.w3d_type_unlink_80247374: Removes the object from its type registry and decrements the registry's live count.
descriptions.w3d_type_construct_802473b8: Constructs an object of this type: initializes the base object, installs the vtable and resets its fields.
descriptions.w3d_type_destroy_802473fc: Destroys an object of this type, releasing its members and base part; frees the memory when flag bit 0 is set.
descriptions.w3d_type_register_8024744c: Appears to declare this type's script-visible properties from static tables, then finishes its script registration.
